body:
The idea of solving this issue-report by exposing a function that allows users to provide a `Transform2D` to make adjustments, makes sense.
I have looked over the changes and didn't see any red flags. But I didn't test the implementation.
The naming of the exposed function is fitting.
Documentation is (at least for me) understandable.
When not implementing the new function, the functionality stays the same.

Since the exposed function interferes somewhat with `stretch_shrink`, have you thought about mentioning this interference in the documentation of the exposed member `stretch_shrink`? I'm not sure, if this is absolutely necessary, since this is a very minor use-case.
